summary: Lazy-import heavy CLI subcommand modules to fix slow --help/--version

delivery.outcome: `koru --help`/`koru --version` (and every other subcommand not actually invoked) no longer eagerly import koru.autonomous, koru.cli_auto, koru.cli_scan, koru.git_cli, koru.autopilot.cli_command, koru.autoloop_cli or koru.cli_ide_router at module-import time. `import koru.cli` drops from ~0.6s to ~0.3s, removing the dashboard/MCP/nlp2uri cost chain from trivial CLI calls, which was causing WUP's 5s (now 15s) quick-probe timeout to flake under load.
nonGoals: no change to subcommand behavior or output
no change to the mock.patch("koru._legacy_cli_impl.autonomous_main", ...) test contract
no resolution of the underlying koru-shell TestQL flakiness itself (WUP/STARTER-667), only the root-cause import cost it exposed

architecture.decision: Route scan/git/autopilot/autoloop/dev through the existing _lazy_module_main pattern already used by most subcommands. Turn autonomous_main and stop_prior_autonomous_for_auto_start into thin wrapper functions that import koru.autonomous only when called, preserving mock.patch("koru._legacy_cli_impl.autonomous_main", ...) since the attribute still exists at import time. In the koru.cli package compat shim, replace the eager `from koru.cli_ide_router import ide_router_main` and `from koru.cli_auto import _auto_main` with a module __getattr__ that imports on first access.

validation.evidence: existing autonomous/auto dispatch tests and mock.patch targets on koru._legacy_cli_impl keep passing
ide_router_main/_auto_main stay importable from koru.cli and behave identically

commands: python3 -c "import time; t0=time.monotonic(); import koru.cli; print(time.monotonic()-t0)"
validation.evidence: import koru.cli drops from ~0.6s to ~0.3s; koru.autonomous/cli_ide_router/cli_auto/cli_scan/git_cli/autopilot.cli_command/autoloop_cli absent from -X importtime output for `koru --version`
